description: This file defines the ServicePeriod class, which extends FilterField and provides functionality to add date-based filtering conditions related to an employee's service duration within a human resource management system. It utilizes traits and external query builder components to construct database queries based on operator and date parameters.

classes.name: ServicePeriod
classes.description: A class providing date-based filtering for employee service periods in HRM reports, supporting comparison operators like less than, greater than, and between.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and date range parameters, defining the logic to filter employees by their service duration.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in query contexts, in this case ['employee'].
